seasonRead.headline: 2015–16: Puck responsibility separates creators from support
paragraphs: High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer combines scoring, possession extension and giveaways—the familiar statistical footprint of players trusted to try difficult things with the puck and carry more of the attack.

High-Volume Playmaking Scorer creates through a more connective blend of assists, takeaways and chance quality. Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist carries more of the block-and-support workload, so the forward pool looks built around who drives the decision and who makes the next decision possible.

seasonRead.headline: 2015–16: The best defense starts with the puck moving north
paragraphs: Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman is the largest blue-line family, pairing production and takeaways with a favorable chance share. In hockey terms, the role is to turn a recovery into progression rather than settle for a blind clear.

Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman and Physical Shutdown Defenseman cover the other half of the job: shooting-lane work, contact and the physical cost of absorbing pressure. High block volume still describes exposure as much as effectiveness, which is why a puck mover matters beside it.
